title: Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic (剑痴 花千笑) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic (剑痴 花千笑) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic (剑痴 花千笑) phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic (剑痴 花千笑) is a story encounter in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest, found at Pangzhen Bridge Overlook. Beating it yields The Fanatic's Broken Blade.

sections.title: Where to Find the Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic (剑痴 花千笑)
sections.content:
Location: Pangzhen Bridge Overlook.

Appears in: Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic (剑痴 花千笑)
sections.content:
What works

  • Let his fast sword string finish before countering; interrupting mid-combo gets you punished.
  • He is the boss most likely to teach you that mashing loses to patience.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 10 of 60 in the progression order, in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest. Before it: Acolyte Hansui. After it: Jing Ye, the Outlaw (亡命徒 荆野). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
